# Documentation MCP

Public MCP Documentation Server — Federated RAG for the MCP ecosystem.
Indexes and searches fleet-wide documentation with semantic vector retrieval.

- README: https://github.com/sandraschi/documentation-mcp/blob/master/README.md
- Full docs: llms-full.txt
- Fleet standards: https://github.com/sandraschi/mcp-central-docs
- Webapp: http://localhost:11032 (frontend), http://localhost:11033 (backend)
- Ports: 11032 frontend, 11033 backend (fleet registry)
- Stack: Python 3.13+, FastMCP 3.2+, FastAPI, React/Vite, TailwindCSS, LanceDB RAG
- Tauri 2.0 native: NSIS installer with embedded PyInstaller backend

## Key Tools
- search_docs: Semantic search across indexed documentation
- ask_docs: Synthesized answers via LLM sampling with fallback to local models
- get_document: Retrieves full content of a documentation file by path
- reindex_docs: Forces full re-scan and re-indexing of all docs
- chunk_stats: Index health metrics
- server_status: Server health, version, and memory summary
- start_webapp: Launches the webapp automatically
- agentic_doc_workflow: Autonomous research workflows via MCP sampling

## Entry Points
- uv run docs-mcp → stdio MCP server
- uv run uvicorn docs_mcp.server:app → HTTP server
- ./start.ps1 → full stack (backend + frontend + auto-open browser)
